parts.problem_md:
Here is a cuboid.

![Rectangular prism with dimensions: length 15 cm, width 6 cm, height 12 cm. Note states "Diagram NOT accurately drawn" on the right.](assets/001-rectangular-prism-with-dimensions-length-15-cm-w.png)

Work out the volume of the cuboid.
parts.solution_md:
> **[exam-tip]**
> Always check that the units of lengths given are the same first.

> *The formula for the volume of a cuboid is length*$\times$*width*$\times$*height*

> *Substitute the values into the formula*

$15\times6\times12=1080$

**[M1]**

**Final answer:** **1080cm**<sup>**3**</sup>

**[A1]**

parts.problem_md:
The diagram shows a cuboid.

![3D rectangular prism with dimensions 7 cm, 6 cm, and width w cm. Note: Diagram not accurately drawn.](assets/002-3d-rectangular-prism-with-dimensions-7-cm-6-cm-a.png)

The volume of the cuboid is 231cm<sup>3</sup>

Calculate the value of $w$
parts.solution_md:
> *Volume of a cuboid = length × width × height*

> *Here *$7\timesw\times6=231$

> *Multiply the two lengths given together*

$7\times6=42$

> *Divide the volume by these two lengths to find *$w$

$231\div42=5.5$

**[M1]**

**Final answer:** **5.5**

**[A1]**

> **[mark-scheme]**
> **A1**: Equivalent answers of $\frac{11}{2}$ or $5\frac{1}{2}$are equally acceptable.

parts.problem_md:
![Diagram showing a crate measuring 120 cm by 40 cm by h cm, and a box measuring 20 cm on each side. Note: Diagram not accurately drawn.](assets/003-diagram-showing-a-crate-measuring-120-cm-by-40-c.png)

A crate is in the shape of a cuboid with inside lengths of 120 cm, 40 cm and $h$ cm 
The crate has a lid.

Micah has 48 boxes. 
Each box is in the shape of a cube 20 cm by 20 cm by 20 cm

Micah wants to put all the boxes in the crate and shut the lid.

Work out the least possible value of $h$
parts.solution_md:
> *Work out how many boxes could fit on each layer of the crate*

$120\div20=6\mathrm{boxes} \mathrm{across}$

$40\div20=2\mathrm{boxes} \mathrm{deep}$

**[M1]**

$6\times2=12$

> *Each layer would have 12 boxes*

> *Work out how many layers would be needed*

$48\div12=4\mathrm{layers}$

**[M1]**

> *Each layer is 20cm tall*

$4\times20\mathrm{cm}=80\mathrm{cm}$

**[M1]**

**Final answer:** **80cm**

**[A1]**
